run_deconvnet_saliency: run the deconvnet function to compute saliency maps for a given model, input tensor, and category ID
get_example_data: get example data including a pretrained model, sample image tensor, and ImageNet category IDs for visualization demos
plot_example_saliency: plot an example input image alongside its computed saliency map using the plot_example function
create_deconvnet_context: create a DeConvNetContext to modify gradient computation with the DeConvNet ReLU definition for manual backpropagation
review_deconvnet_relu: review the DeConvNetReLU autograd function that redefines ReLU backward to clamp gradients at zero
